plugin.name: ob-menu
plugin._long: Openbox menu.xml menu system themed by themerc menu.* keys.

option.name: theme_name
option._long: Openbox theme for the menu, used only when no other ob_* consumer (ob-decor) has initialized a theme yet. Empty = built-in defaults.

option.name: menu_file
option._long: Path to an openbox menu.xml. Empty = ~/.config/openbox/menu.xml, then built-in defaults.

option.name: font
option._long: Pango font description used when the menu fonts below are empty.

option.name: key_client_menu
option._long: Opens the client-menu at the titlebar of the focused window.

option.name: key_root_menu
option._long: Opens the root menu at the cursor position.
